text:
maya-partners: Quick touch — VelaLabs wants to list two SKUs: hosted API and a BYOW bundle that requires TEE attestation (they use AMD SEV). They also want a marketplace flag that indicates attested artifacts only. Can we do that?

tim-legal: Short: hosted API = yes. BYOW + attestation = ok but need contract language about attestation claims and a verification audit right. Also export control + sanctions check on training provenance.

eva-solutions: SI needs an attestation verification step in the install bundle. Ideally we get the attestation quote (base64) plus signing cert chain so SIs can validate runtime enclave. Need sample command to verify.

leo-hw: HW note: SEV attestation flow requires a verifier that can reach the AMD attestation service or use offline quote verification. If partner can't expose the verifier service, they must include the quote and the endorsement cert chain. We'll also want firmware/PSP versions.

maya-partners: Partner says they can provide quote+certs and are willing to run an attestation-on-upload CI to our marketplace staging. They asked if attestation failures should block listing or just mark as "unattested".

tim-legal: Prefer blocking for BYOW attested-tag SKUs. If partner requests non-blocking, require explicit consumer notice and indemnity. We also need to record attestation timestamp and verifier identity in the manifest.

eva-solutions: Agreed. For SI installs we need a verification helper script example. I'll draft a small snippet. Example they provided (mock):

```
# verify_sev_quote.sh
# inputs: quote.b64, endorsement.pem
base64 -d quote.b64 > quote.bin
amd-sev-verify --quote quote.bin --endorsement endorsement.pem --out result.json
jq '.is_valid' result.json
```

leo-hw: :thumbsup: add firmware field to the manifest: psp_version, microcode_date. If mismatch, flag for manual review.

maya-partners: KMS question: partner wants to reference customer KMS for key wrapping of the symmetric model artifact and also include a sealed key inside the TEE. Is that acceptable?

eva-solutions: Yes, we can document two workflows: 1) KMS-wrapped artifact (download uses CMK unwrap), 2) sealed-key inside enclave for runtime-only decryption. Docs must show key rotation implications.

tim-legal: Contract note: require partner to provide a description of sealed-key lifecycle and attest that sealed keys don't leak plaintext. Add audit rights for a period of 24 months.

maya-partners: Partner sent a mock manifest schema with attestation fields. Pasting snippet: 

```
{
  "model": "vela-13b",
  "ver": "2026-06-10",
  "digest": "sha256:7f8e...",
  "attestation": {
    "quote_b64": "MIIB...",
    "endorsement_chain": ["-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----..."],
    "verifier": "vela-labs-staging",
    "psp_version": "2.1",
    "attest_time": "2026-06-09T18:22:00Z"
  },
  "kms_wrapped_key": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:999900009999:key/kkkk-llll",
  "geo_allow": ["US","EU"]
}
```

maya-partners: They asked whether the endorsement_chain can be stored encrypted in our bucket and whether we need to store the quote plaintext.

leo-hw: Store the endorsement chain encrypted at rest and keep the quote plaintext (or base64) so auditors can re-run verification. Ensure S3 bucket has restricted ACLs.

eva-solutions: Docs action: I'll add an "Attested BYOW" section with verification snippet, expected manifest fields, and example responses. Also include KMS rotation notes: rotating CMKs requires re-wrapping artifacts and re-attestation if sealed keys change.

tim-legal: I'll draft contract language that: 1) requires attestation evidence, 2) allows us to reject claims if attestation fails, 3) requires retention of attestation logs for 24 months, and 4) includes export/compliance warrantees. Draft due Mon.

infra-bot: created ticket PARTNERS-5011 for TEE attestation marketplace flow  https://redwood.company/issue/PARTNERS-5011

docs-bot: created PR #842 in docs to add attested BYOW quickstart (stub)  https://redwood.company/pr/842

maya-partners: Announcement sequencing question: partner wants a co-launch with joint blog and a live demo showing remote attestation. Any objections?

eva-solutions: Demo is fine but ensure demo artifacts are on staging and keys are ephemeral. We'll coordinate an SI-run-through before demo.

tim-legal: Make sure demo script doesn't expose secret keys or allow extraction of sealed keys. Add a checklist for demo ops.

maya-partners: OK will schedule a rehearsal. Next steps recap: Eva to add docs stub + verify snippet, Tim to draft addendum, Leo to confirm HW verifier checklist, Maya to coordinate partner artifacts and demo rehearsal. We'll reconvene next Tue after PR + addendum land.
